EnableCritical.Name: Effect on critical successes
EnableCritical.Hint: Shows the golden effect on a natural 20 (or the weapon's critical threshold).

EnableFumble.Name: Effect on critical failures
EnableFumble.Hint: Shows the dark effect on a natural 1.

RollTypes.Name: Rolls affected
RollTypes.Hint: Which d20 rolls trigger the effect.

Audience.Name: Who sees the effect
Audience.Hint: Private or blind rolls only trigger it for users who can see them.
Audience.Visible: Everyone who can see the roll

IncludeNpc.Name: Include NPCs
IncludeNpc.Hint: Uncheck to only trigger the effect for player characters.

CriticalSound.Name: Critical success sound
CriticalSound.Hint: Audio file to play. Leave empty for the built-in chime.

FumbleSound.Name: Critical failure sound
FumbleSound.Hint: Audio file to play. Leave empty for the built-in knell.

Volume.Name: Effect volume
Volume.Hint: Multiplied by Foundry's interface volume. 0 mutes.

Duration.Name: Effect duration (seconds)
Duration.Hint: Click the effect to dismiss it early.

Shake.Name: Shake on critical failures
Shake.Hint: Shakes the scene on a natural 1.

Test.Name: Test the effects
Test.Label: Test
Test.Hint: Opens a window to preview both effects.

Themes.Name: Visuals
Themes.Label: Choose visuals
Themes.Hint: Enable or disable each of the 20 visuals and preview them. One is picked at random for each critical, the same for every player.

DamageThemes.Name: Visual by damage type
DamageThemes.Hint: On attacks, the visual follows the damage type (fire → dragon or phoenix, cold → frost…). Otherwise random.

ChatCard.Name: Critical chat card
ChatCard.Hint: The roll message takes the colors of the drawn visual, with a title banner.

PortraitMode.Name: Character portrait
PortraitMode.Hint: Image shown translucently behind the visual.

Display.Name: Effect display
Display.Hint: Full screen, around the token on the map, or both.

Heroes.Name: Hero portraits
Heroes.Label: Customize heroes
Heroes.Hint: Image and quote for each player character's criticals and fumbles.

Test.Text: Only you see these previews. Each click picks a random visual.

Themes.Text: Each critical picks a random visual among the checked ones. Every player sees the same one. Click the eye to preview (only you see it).
Themes.NoneWarning: At least one visual must stay enabled: all were re-enabled.

Heroes.Text: For each player character: an image shown translucently behind the visual, and a quote replacing the tagline. Leave empty to use the sheet portrait.
